proposed_widenings.name: ignore_environmental_hazard
proposed_widenings.justification: The ring's second mechanic — 'unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower' — is environmental survival protection. It is not cold damage immunity (grant_damage_immunity covers combat damage, not environment), not a condition immunity, and not any existing effect atom. The SRD Extreme Cold rule (Playing-the-Game#Hazards or equivalent) creates hazard effects for unprotected creatures; this atom blocks those hazard effects for the wearer and their carried equipment. No v4 atom covers environment-scoped hazard suppression.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower

notes: Mechanic 1 (cold damage reduction 2d8) encodes cleanly as a passive reduce_damage_taken grant; typecheck and tracer both pass. Mechanic 2 (environmental temperature immunity ≤0°F) has no matching atom — it is a survival/exploration hazard suppressor, distinct from combat damage immunity. The encoded content is honest: only the clean mechanic is represented; the omitted mechanic is documented in the proposal.
